claims.hypothesis: Does jet-cloud interaction quench star formation in filament molecular gas?
claims.experiment: ALMA CO(2-1) clumps, SEST CO, GALEX/Herschel SFR, alpha_CO corrections
claims.finding: Star formation is inefficient along the jet, perhaps from turbulence injected by the jet or wind

evidence.loc: Conclusion
evidence.quote: The jet-cloud interaction seems to quench star formation in the molecular gas lying along the jet or wind trajectory, at least in the regions observed.

limitations_admitted.value: Clumps are unresolved and the metallicity at the ALMA position is unknown

evidence.loc: Clumpy CO emission highlighted by ALMA
evidence.quote: there is no measurement of the true metallicity at the scale of the ALMA observations.

Virial analysis depends strongly on alpha_CO choice
Galactic cirrus contaminates the IR SFR
